I like a bold, statement look -- maybe tortoiseshell.

Based on your round face and preference for a bold, statement style with tortoiseshell, **Meridian Form 420** is the closest match:

- **Tortoise acetate frame** with a rectangular outline, **₹1,150 frame-only**, and listed for narrow faces. [3]
- Rectangular frames are **conventionally suggested** for round faces because they add visual structure; this is a styling guideline, not a fitting requirement. [A1]
- The catalog labels it **minimal and professional**, so it may not deliver the full bold statement effect you requested. [3]

### Other options

- **Halcyon Type 165** — catalog-labeled **bold and playful**, with a geometric outline and medium-face fit, **₹1,150**; however, it is olive rather than tortoise. [1]
- **Orbit&Co Line 323** — also catalog-labeled **bold and playful**, geometric, medium-face fit, **₹1,200**; it is olive rather than tortoise. [2]
- **Sundial Mark 866** — havana acetate with patterned temples, **₹1,800**, and listed for narrow faces; the catalog labels it minimal and professional rather than bold. [5]

**Nothing in this catalog fully combines all three preferences: a bold statement style, tortoiseshell coloring, and a round-face styling match.** Meridian is the closest option but drops some of the boldness; Halcyon and Orbit&Co preserve the bold style but drop the tortoiseshell color.

**Assumption:** your face width is still unknown, so I’m relying only on each frame’s catalog category—narrow or medium—not confirming your actual fit. If your face is medium rather than narrow, Halcyon or Orbit&Co may be the more relevant options; an in-store measurement would settle that. Also, since you do not yet know your prescription, the listed “Rx compatible” limits—meaning the prescription strength the frame is designed to accept—should be checked after your eye examination. [1][2][3][5]
